Head of Product — Credit Cards, Dublin hybrid.

Shamrock Credit (Dublin, 55 people, Series A, founder-led) is launching a credit-builder card for Irish consumers who are new to credit. We're hiring our first Head of Product to own the card product end to end — underwriting, pricing experiments and activation — leading two PMs and reporting to the CEO. Hybrid, three days a week in our Dublin office; we offer relocation within Europe. Candidates must already have the right to work in Ireland; we are unable to sponsor visas for this role.
